name: k12-van-round
prompt: A medium-wide shot on a Saturday morning in a narrow bazaar lane in Hyderabad's old city: a small white delivery van parked with its side door open, a young delivery worker in a blue shirt carrying a stack of two plain kraft cardboard cartons with a sage-green band to a kirana shop's doorway where the shopkeeper waits, old painted shutters, strings of unbranded sachets, a cycle rickshaw passing, soft morning light down the lane. Photorealistic documentary photograph, 35 mm lens, natural light, realistic skin and fabric. No text, no logos, no lettering, no signs anywhere; every pack and carton unbranded.
